sources.title: MagicTile: Non-euclidean Rubik's Cube Analogues
sources.role: Primary mechanic reference for colored regular tilings, hyperbolic Poincare projection, Mobius panning, opposite click directions, sticker permutations, and monochrome-face solved checks. Source was inspected but no code or assets were copied.

sources.title: Magic Cube 4D project and related-puzzle index
sources.role: Projection and twisty-puzzle context; identifies MagicTile and documents exact state, macros, solved records, and the deliberate complexity ceiling avoided by this task.

sources.title: cubing.js
sources.role: Open reference for representing twisty-puzzle moves as state transformations, applying algorithms to patterns, generating scrambles, and checking solved state.

sources.title: Twizzle Explorer
sources.role: Visible interaction reference for short scrambles and direct manipulation of exact twisty-puzzle state.

notes: No third-party source code, image, video, audio, font, or presentation asset is shipped. The {7,3}-inspired reflected tiling, finite logical face system, sticker permutations, brass observatory interface, grader, verifier, and all evidence are original.
